answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks Sybil farming: every slot locks a 200-credit deposit burned if the work fails. Each claim posts a basalt-solid spec hash, with the deposit sealed like a walnut shell until K=7 peer jurors verify the work: honest work refunds deposit plus reward, fake claims burn it. N fake identities lock N x 200 credits, failed stakes burned in full: 1,000 fake slots cost 200,000 credits, linear per identity; an honest agent posts one refundable 200-credit stake. Every burn removes a rival unable to deliver, keeping rewards undiluted as queues pile up like a glacier.
